verdict.rationale: Cekura's observability ingestion accepts a recording URL alongside the transcript and metadata and stores it as a CallLog. Its PII redaction also operates on audio recordings, so audio is captured and processed as part of observed calls. However, the evidence only shows audio attached at the call level, via a URL, for voice agents. Nothing shows a developer attaching arbitrary multimodal payloads within traces. Missing for 10: image capture, arbitrary file attachments, span/trace-level multimodal attachment API (e.g. in the LiveKit tracing SDK), independent corroboration.
